values.ui_help23: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
